name: linkupapi
label: LinkupAPI
description: LinkupAPI lets agents send messages, manage conversations, and automate outreach across every channel, for sales and recruitment.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your LinkupAPI key, sent as the `x-api-key` header. Get it from https://app.linkupapi.com

list_accounts.label: List Accounts
list_accounts.description: List all connected LinkedIn accounts linked to your API key. Free (0 credits). Use the returned account_id in other actions.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max accounts to return per page (1-500)

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of accounts to skip (for pagination)

get_account.label: Get Account Details
get_account.description: Get detailed information and status for a specific connected account. Free (0 credits).

get_my_profile.label: Get My Profile
get_my_profile.description: Retrieve the profile of the connected LinkedIn account.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

get_profile.label: Get Profile Info
get_profile.description: Retrieve detailed information about a LinkedIn profile by URL, public identifier, or URN.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

profileUrl.label: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: Full LinkedIn profile URL (provide this OR Identifier OR URN)

search_people.label: Search People
search_people.description: Search LinkedIn profiles by keyword, company, title, location, school, industry and more. Returns the LinkedIn URL of each match.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

network.label: Network
network.description: Connection degree relative to the account

connectionOf.label: Connection Of
connectionOf.description: Show connections of a specific profile (URL or identifier)

followerOf.label: Follower Of
followerOf.description: Show followers of a specific company or profile

fetchInvitationState.label: Fetch Invitation State
fetchInvitationState.description: Include the connection invitation state for each result

totalResults.label: Total Results
totalResults.description: Number of results to return (1 credit per 10 results)

search_companies.label: Search Companies
search_companies.description: Search LinkedIn companies by keyword, location, sector and company size.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

get_company.label: Get Company Info
get_company.description: Retrieve detailed information about a LinkedIn company page.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

send_message.label: Send Message
send_message.description: Send a LinkedIn message to a profile, optionally with a media attachment.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

profileUrl.label: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the recipient

messageText.label: Message
messageText.description: The text of the message to send

mediaLink.label: Media Link
mediaLink.description: Optional URL of a media file to attach

get_conversation.label: Get Conversation
get_conversation.description: Retrieve the message history of a LinkedIn conversation, by conversation ID or profile URL.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

conversationId.label: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: Provide this OR a Profile URL

profileUrl.label: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: Profile URL of the other participant

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

send_connection_request.label: Send Connection Request
send_connection_request.description: Send a LinkedIn connection invitation to a profile, with an optional note.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.

profileUrl.label: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL (provide this OR Identifier)

message.label: Note
message.description: Optional note to include with the invitation

check_invitation_status.label: Check Invitation Status
check_invitation_status.description: Check the status of a connection invitation sent to a profile.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The connected LinkedIn account to act as. Get it from the "List Accounts" action.
